Communication and Collaboration

How do I engage stakeholders digitally?

Short Answer

Select an accessible channel that suits the audience, provide clear information and make it easy for people to participate and respond.

Detailed Guidance

Identify who needs to participate and what input you need before selecting an online channel. Provide plain-language, accessible information, offer an appropriate way to contribute, and explain how feedback will be considered and followed up.
